description: Raw transit (Gochara) details for EVERY day in a date range, in one call. For the 'AI decides' flow: returns the full per-day snapshot (panchanga, muhurta windows incl. clean Abhijit, all 9 planets, Ashtakavarga, Gochara-phala/Vedha, and the native's Tara/Chandra bala and Sade Sati) with NO scoring or 'best date' selection — you reason and decide. Natal reference computed once. Range capped at 60 days. Use get_muhurta instead if you want the system to rank dates by rules.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

event_place.description: Event place name (optional; defaults to birth place)

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

include.description: Enrichment sections (default all). Pass [] for lean per-day output.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

time_of_day.description: Time used per day (default local noon)

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST

name: get_gochara_range
title: Transit Range (Gochara)
